arguments.sql:
SELECT s.School,
       s.GSoffered,
       f.CDSCode AS frpm_cds_code,
       f."Academic Year",
       f."Low Grade",
       f."High Grade",
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)",
       f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)",
       f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-9'
ORDER BY s.School
